title: Tropical cyclone, Bangladesh, 18 May 2020 (TC20200518BGD)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Tropical cyclone, Bangladesh, 18 May 2020 (TC20200518BGD), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: TC20200518BGD**  This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Bagerhat, Jessore, Khulna, Narail, and Satkhira district of Khulna division, Bangladesh as observed from a Sentinel-1 image acquired on 25 May 2020. Within the analyzed area of about 8,320 km2, a total of about 1,000 km2 of lands appear to be flooded.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.

HDX datasets:

- [Satellite detected waters in Khulna division, Bangladesh](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-waters-in-khulna-division-bangladesh-as-of-25-may-2020)
- [Satellite detected waters in Khulna division, Bangladesh as of 31 May 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-waters-in-khulna-division-bangladesh-as-of-31-may-2020)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for how the collections were built.
